categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in new energy charging piles, automotive comprehensive diagnostics, testing and analysis systems, and automotive electronic components. Its main products include automotive comprehensive diagnostic products, TPMS (Tire Pressure Monitoring System) series, ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance System) series, new energy charging piles, and related software cloud services. The company serves global markets including the US, Europe, Japan, Australia, and over 70 countries and regions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced automotive diagnostic communication systems, intelligent charging algorithms powered by AI, liquid cooling technology for ultra-fast charging piles, and cloud-based management platforms. The company employs modular design, AI-driven load balancing, and vehicle-to-grid (V2G) bidirectional charging technologies. Production mainly involves assembly, functional testing, and quality inspection, with SMT processes outsourced or self-operated in Vietnam.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large automotive repair chains, independent repair shops, energy companies, fleet operators, and retail consumers. Major markets are North America, Europe, China, and other global regions. The company has strategic partnerships with leading industry players and serves both B2B and B2C segments, including e-commerce platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with operations and sales in North America (notably the US), Europe (Germany, Italy, UK, France, Spain, Sweden, Netherlands), Asia-Pacific (China, Japan, Vietnam, Australia), Latin America (Mexico, Brazil), Middle East (Dubai), and Africa. It has established manufacturing bases in Vietnam and the US, and sales subsidiaries in multiple countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive and new energy supply chains. It develops and manufactures diagnostic and charging equipment, assembles products, and provides software and cloud services. It sources electronic components and materials from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products to end customers and service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating R&D in new energy vehicle charging solutions, expanding intelligent automotive diagnostics, and enhancing cloud-based software services. The company focuses on ultra-fast charging, AI-driven smart charging and maintenance, vehicle-to-grid integration, and global compatibility. It invests heavily in AI, big data, and digital transformation to improve product performance and customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of automotive diagnostics, TPMS, ADAS, and new energy charging piles. Additionally, the company earns recurring income from software cloud services, including subscription-based software upgrades and remote expert services. Sales channels include direct sales, distributors, e-commerce platforms, and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major global players such as Bosch, Snap-on, and Yuan Zheng Technology in automotive diagnostics. It is recognized as a leading global provider in intelligent automotive diagnostics and new energy charging solutions, with strong market presence in developed markets like North America and Europe. Its competitive advantages stem from broad vehicle compatibility, advanced technology, and global supply chain capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 3.25 billion, a 43.5% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 179 million, up 75.66%. The new energy charging pile segment grew explosively by 493.21%. The company maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 5.5 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for 18.34% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering intelligent, reliable, and high-performance automotive diagnostic and charging solutions with broad vehicle compatibility and advanced AI capabilities. Its ultra-fast charging technology rivals refueling speed, and its cloud platforms provide comprehensive operational and maintenance management. The integration of vehicle, charging pile, and network systems creates a seamless user experience and operational efficiency, differentiating it in the global market.
